blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 38 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (September 25, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & MRNA lead 38 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 23 Canadian and 15 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of September 25, 2026) found 38 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 23 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 11 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +140% six-month return, and Materials is the most represented sector with 12 names.

In the U.S., 15 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 10 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +311% six-month return, and Information Technology is the most represented sector with 8 names.
